_comment: The one place that holds every library of the W3CSS Theme. Edit this file, then run: python3 -I scripts/build-libraries.py (it writes drupal8_w3css_theme.libraries.yml and src/SchemeLibraries.php; --check fails on drift). A library with 'was' also gets a deprecated alias under the old id (alias:false for ids that never shipped). 'also_was' lists more released ids folded into one library; each gets a deprecated alias. 'stored' is the color_scheme.predefined value that selects a scheme library. 'gap:false' = no blank line before it in the yml.
